title: Nice set for the aesthetics/ambience. Giftable..
text:
Nice set for the aesthetics/ambience. Giftable... As one who burns candle daily- I was hoping for solid quality as these are universal in color/style- aesthetically able to look the part in any space.. Perfect tub side, desktop, nightstand- they are small in their little violative.

Scent isn’t as strong as I hoped for- pear/freesia is strongest but throw only reaches x1-2ft. Westin and coco (my most anticipated!) we’re waxy scent.. they aren’t off-putting but nothing of identifiable fragrance. I find these are pretty and can be lit for aesthetics or ambience.. but not remember for their scent.

Included photos to show relateable sizing- cute appearance.. and also, the quirky end burn to 1 of the 3.. as if wick was too close to glass?

Giftable.. in a padded long flip box- the look is classy!! Matches any decor and is unisex. Hoping info helps decision.. stay safe everyone.
